name: Stacked Cards
description: A card animation template from Anagram where cards fan out and reveal in sequence. Works great for testimonials and any content that benefits from a one-at-a-time reveal format.

name: Config: Photo Gallery 01
description: The first animated photo gallery template from the Config series. Good for design conference content and visual work presentations.

name: Config: Photo Gallery 02
description: A second animated photo gallery template from the Config series. Perfect for design conference content and visual work presentations.

name: Config: Photo Gallery 03
description: A third animated photo gallery template from the Config series with a different compositional feel. Good for design community content and visual storytelling.

name: Feature Sneak Peek
description: A teaser template from Vendredi Society that partially reveals an upcoming feature. Good for pre-launch social content where you want to build anticipation without giving everything away.

name: Holo
description: A holographic shimmer animation template from Luc Chaissac with iridescent color shifts. Good for premium product showcases and brand content that wants a distinctive futuristic quality.

name: Instruction Card
description: An animated instruction card template that presents steps one at a time in a clear layout. Great for onboarding flows and how-to content.

name: NFT Cards: 3D
description: A 3D animated card template from Rico showing digital artwork rotating in space. Perfect for digital collectibles showcases and product presentations.

name: Ready For Config
description: An animated template celebrating Figma Config. Good for Figma community posts and design conference content.

name: Thank You Config
description: An animated thank you card template for Figma Config. Good for post-conference community posts and event recap content.

name: Zero Gravity: Floating Cards
description: Cards drift weightlessly in space, slowly rotating and bobbing as if in zero gravity. Good for product card showcases and floating UI hero shots.
